svg.title: Plus/4 TED character glyphs: uppercase/graphics then lowercase/uppercase
svg.desc: Two banks of 256 screen-code glyphs. Codes 128-255 are hardware-inverse of 0-127 (default TED text mode). Extracted from kernal.318005-05.bin offset 0x1000. Source charset SHA-256: fbad799017b47bf944dec698f33729a8014db32a73129b5c512a639c1ad12b6a. Display atlas SHA-256: 1bc59062292b207e0e0cd6da35503a2334ff7dec462a7bc6aec021ddde16fed4
